### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/service-analytics`, touching **14** documentable anchor(s).

**17** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c9a9981dae1803fe5270c2171605c1c06508ee89`.

⛔ **5** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **60** of **216** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **156** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **156**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **101** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **10** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c9a9981dae1803fe5270c2171605c1c06508ee89` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `f6475433a462764bb5d7d3a0f088cabe2f6d4d5b` — the merge of head `d26d29b40aaf118afde7ab286928849d70991e0d` into base `c9a9981dae1803fe5270c2171605c1c06508ee89`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin f6475433a462764bb5d7d3a0f088cabe2f6d4d5b && git checkout f6475433a462764bb5d7d3a0f088cabe2f6d4d5b
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin c9a9981dae1803fe5270c2171605c1c06508ee89 d26d29b40aaf118afde7ab286928849d70991e0d && git checkout -B drift-repro c9a9981dae1803fe5270c2171605c1c06508ee89 && git merge --no-ff d26d29b40aaf118afde7ab286928849d70991e0d

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c9a9981dae1803fe5270c2171605c1c06508ee89
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs c9a9981dae1803fe5270c2171605c1c06508ee89` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `722fbe7c32a853bd5bb883bf8957778a7d108754`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/services/service-analytics/src/analytics-service.ts, packages/services/service-analytics/src/preview-group-column-door.ts, packages/services/service-analytics/src/strategies/objectql-strategy.ts, packages/services/service-analytics/src/__tests__/preview-time-filter-fk-parity.test.ts + packages/services/service-analytics/src/index.ts (root exports), packages/services/service-analytics/package.json, packages/services/service-analytics/src/strategies/native-sql-strategy.ts (`canHandle`), packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-compiler.ts (cube `sql`), packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-executor.ts (`resolveDimensionGranularity`), packages/objectql/src/aggregate-query-shape-door.ts, packages/objectql/src/engine.ts (`aggregate` entry), packages/objectql/src/index.ts, packages/objectql/src/core.ts, packages/objectql/package.json, packages/spec/src/contracts/analytics-service.ts (`queryDataset`), packages/spec/src/api/analytics.zod.ts (selection granularity), docs/adr/0037-live-canvas-draft-preview.md. The changeset is a prose face: read for ②, not reviewed.

Inputs: card #28765 body and its four comments (triage `6561970070`, claim `6562387005`, Resume-from correction `6562400528`, os-dev-report `6563232009`); PR #28794 body, its 5-file list, and the net diff of `origin/claude/project-thread-0o422x` against merge-base `8afaf12d` (191 added / 13 deleted); the head's check-runs. Check-runs at the time of this record: 52 on the head, 44 completed and none failed (success or skipped; among the successes Check Changeset, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Build Core, Lint · ESLint, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Type Check · workspace / source gates / consumer gates / debt ledger, Dogfood Regression Gate, Test UI, Live E2E UI, PR-body guards), 8 still in progress: `Test Core (1/8)` to `Test Core (8/8)`. The gate verdicts are theirs; nothing was run here.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **Accept-set narrowing on the draft preview — right.** `answerDataset`'s preview branch (`previewDrafts: true` with a pending seed) now asks `assertPreviewGroupColumnsDistinct(dataset.object, this.objectqlStrategy.groupByOf(q, cube))` last in its gate list. Read in the tree: the keys are the ones `ObjectQLStrategy.execute` hands `engine.aggregate` (the `groupBy` build moved into `groupByOf` byte for byte: one key per `dimensions` entry, then one per bucketed `timeDimensions` entry, deduplicated by `pushGroupKey`), and the engine refuses two of them projecting one column in `assertAggregatedColumnsAreDistinct` (`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`, the `aggregate` entry, after the JSON-field, aggregate-type, record-currency and temporal-bucket doors). So the preview now refuses exactly the selections the engine refuses for the same keys, and only those. The card's shape (dimension `closed_at` beside `OBJECT.closed_at` bucketed by month) reaches two keys because `granByDim` is keyed by the entry's spelling, so the `dimensions` loop finds no granularity for `closed_at` and pushes it raw, then the bucket is pushed as a second key — the same path on the live face. Right.
2. **The second bucket of one column (different granularities) — right, and a true parity.** The brief asked this be checked against both faces in the tree. ObjectQL face: `groupByOf` yields `{closed_at, month}` and `{closed_at, year}` (distinct keys, not deduplicated), and the engine door's `groupColumnOf` reads `alias ?? field`, so both project `closed_at` and are refused at `groupBy.1.field` naming `groupBy.0.field`. Native face: `NativeSQLStrategy.canHandle` returns false for any `timeDimensions` entry with a granularity (`native-sql-strategy.ts`, the ADR-0053 decline), so every bucketed selection is answered by the ObjectQL strategy through `executeAggregate`, that is by the same engine door. Both live faces refuse it, by one mechanism; the preview copying it is parity, not an over-reach beyond the card. The card's stay-served list (raw beside a bucket of a different column; two dimensions over one column with no bucket) is untouched: different columns are different map keys, and #28744's shared column is deduplicated by `pushGroupKey` before the door sees it. The still-served pins and ablation C4 cover this.
3. **Public-surface widening — WRONG as declared.** `packages/services/service-analytics/src/index.ts` re-exports the class: `export { ObjectQLStrategy } from './strategies/objectql-strategy.js'`. The diff adds a public method on it, `groupByOf(query: AnalyticsQuery, cube: Cube): AggregateGroupKey[]`, and the type it returns; both are reachable from the entry type graph, so the published surface of `@objectstack/service-analytics` gains a member. The PR body says "no export … is added" and "the package root does not export this module"; the first is false, and the second is true only of the module path, not of the class the root re-exports (and `check:dts-closure` is green precisely because the type travels with the class). The diff therefore both narrows (the preview) and widens (the class). See ② and ④ must-fix.
4. **Live faces unchanged — right.** `execute` calls `groupByOf` and proceeds as before; the strategy's keys, order and dedup are the ones on `main`. `packages/objectql` is untouched. The held `objectqlStrategy` instance is the same object placed in the chain (`builtIn` list), so there is one strategy, not two.
5. **Error envelope — right.** `INVALID_QUERY`, `status` and `httpStatus` 400, `object`, `param: 'groupBy'`, `path` (`groupBy.N` for a raw key, `groupBy.N.field` for a bucketed one) and `fields: [column]` match the engine's `refusal` helper member for member; the strategy's keys carry no `alias`, so the `groupBy.N.alias` arm and the aggregations half are rightly not copied. No new error code, status or answer member.
6. **No new failure path before the door — right.** `groupByOf` calls `resolveFieldName`, which never throws (`lookupMember` falls back to a synthetic dimension for a dotted member and to the member itself otherwise); dotted members are refused earlier by `assertPreviewJoinsNothing`, unknown members by `assertDimensionFields` where a field probe exists. A preview without a pending seed falls through to the live path as before.

### ② Semver level

- Changeset `.changeset/28765-preview-refuses-column-raw-beside-bucket.md`: `@objectstack/service-analytics` patch. Under ruling A (`check-changeset-no-major.mjs`, the level axis) the level follows `Metadata-protocol:` alone: `none` takes `patch`, a `fix!:` title included. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right in the tree — no `packages/spec` file, no authorable key, no value an author writes changes. Level: **matches**. The `!` title and the BREAKING banner are right for a declared `(narrowing)` arm. The adr-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` marker is a listed category and its reason holds (no key or export of a schema moves; no stored shape to rewrite); CI's Check Changeset is green.
- `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` in the PR body and the changeset: the narrowing arm is right; the `no` is **not** — ① item 3: a new public method on a root-exported class is a public-surface widening, so the diff's honest line is `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` unless the widening is removed. The level does not move either way (ruling A decouples it), the ADR-0087 disposition does not move, and the served tier does not move; what moves is the declaration's truth, which a contract review exists to check. Must-fix, carried in ④.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev deviation 1 (a copy of the engine's refusal, not a shared helper): **accepted.** Verified in the tree: `@objectstack/objectql` is in `devDependencies` of `service-analytics` only, and neither `packages/objectql/src/index.ts` nor `core.ts` exports `aggregate-query-shape-door`; the alternatives are a new runtime dependency on the engine or a new engine root export, both wider than this card. The copy is pinned by `refusedAsLive`, which compares the preview's refusal with each live face's `toEqual` on message, code, status, httpStatus, object, param, path and fields, so an engine wording change reds the test from either side (ablation C2 shows the copy side; the comparison is symmetric). Note for the reader: the test's two live legs reach one door, because the native face declines every bucketed selection to the ObjectQL strategy; the parity pinned is service face to service face, which is the card's line.
- Dev deviation 2 (two buckets of one column refused too): **accepted** — ① item 2, verified on both faces in the cited code; the changeset names it under Before / Now.
- Dev deviation 3 (rebase onto `8afaf12d`; readings from `3b296a59`): **accepted**; the net diff against the merge base touches the five named files only.
- Dev deviation 4 (branch recreated; PR opened with no labels): **accepted**; the queue guard and PR-body guards are green.
- `Skills-docs: none`: **holds** — no file under `skills/**` or `content/docs/**` on `main` says the draft preview serves a column raw beside its own bucket; `previewDrafts` is documented only as the draft-visibility switch.
- `open_questions`: empty; `out_of_scope_findings`: empty. One observation the dev did not raise, for the lane and not this PR: two `timeDimensions` entries of one spelling (`closed_at` month and `closed_at` year) collapse in `granByDim` to the last granularity and are served as one bucket on the live faces; what the preview evaluator does with that pair is not measured here and is outside this card's shape.
- PR author is `objectstack-fleet[bot]` through the relay; no non-fleet login to name.

### ④ Design judgment

The narrowing, read against the published spec on `main`: `queryDataset`'s contract (`packages/spec/src/contracts/analytics-service.ts`) says `previewDrafts` "evaluates the selection over the base object's PENDING seed-draft rows … so a draft preview charts real numbers before publish"; ADR-0037's design center is that the canvas shows "exactly what Publish will make real", and Phase 3's acceptance is that the same widgets show the same numbers after publish. The selection schema (`analytics.zod.ts`, `dateGranularity`) speaks of one granularity per dimension by precedence; nowhere does the spec declare that a column may be asked raw and bucketed under one name. So the capability the preview loses was never declared, the live refusal is a deliberate decision carried by PR #28762 and held by the card, and the preview's refusal makes the spec's own line real at the consumer that was serving what publish refuses. The narrowing is sound in direction and in scope.

Tried to break it: (a) positions — the preview judges `groupByOf(q, cube)` over the same `q` the `DatasetExecutor` hands the live `query()` (one executor, one compiled dataset, one selection), so the engine's `groupBy.N` positions are the preview's by construction; the only live-side addition before the strategy, `withDeclaredGranularityDefaults`, changes nothing on the dataset path (its header, and the executor fills defaults first); (b) object name — the door is given `dataset.object`, the strategy hands the engine `cube.sql.trim()`, and `compileDataset` sets `sql: dataset.object`, equal today; (c) gate order — the door is last on both faces (the engine's door sits after the JSON, aggregate-type, currency and temporal-bucket doors; the preview's after their mirrors), so a selection with two mistakes is answered about the same one first; (d) a host chain that answers bucketed selections off-engine (`InMemoryStrategy` with `objectqlAggregate: false`) is outside the pin, as it is for every other preview gate that mirrors the engine; nothing in this PR widens or narrows that.

Findings:

- **Must-fix (FAIL).** The diff widens the published surface of `@objectstack/service-analytics` while declaring `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`: `ObjectQLStrategy` is re-exported from `src/index.ts`, and the class gains the public method `groupByOf(query, cube): AggregateGroupKey[]` (① item 3). Two remedies, either acceptable: (a) keep the method and correct the declaration to `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` in both the PR body and the changeset, with the one-line reason that a root-exported class gains a public member (level stays `patch`: `Metadata-protocol: none`); or, preferred, (b) remove the widening — make the keys builder a module-level function of `objectql-strategy.ts` (it reads only the cube: `resolveFieldName` and `lookupMember` touch no instance state) that `execute` and the preview both call, not re-exported from the root, and drop the held `objectqlStrategy` field; then `no (narrowing)` is true and the parity "same keys at the same positions" still holds by construction. Judged on the tree, not the body: the body's "no export … is added" is the sentence the tree contradicts.
- **Should-fix.** `assertPreviewGroupColumnsDistinct(dataset.object, …)`: read the object off the cube as the strategy does (`cube.sql.trim()`, what `execute` hands the engine) so the name in the preview's message cannot drift from the live one; equal today by `compileDataset`, by construction after.
- **Should-fix (a card, not this PR).** The copied remedy sentence, "Give one of the group entries its own 'alias'", is the engine's and is unreachable for a dataset-selection author on every face (a selection carries no alias; the changeset's "ask for the column once" is the real remedy). Parity is right here and the live wording does not move on this card, but the lane owes a finding on the live faces' prescription — an author is told a repair they cannot make.

Reviewed-by: `session_01FEkQ5kE5BrPUPNMMyv6oCH-review-28794`

**VERDICT: FAIL**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `d26d29b40aaf118afde7ab286928849d70991e0d`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/services/service-analytics/src/analytics-service.ts, packages/services/service-analytics/src/preview-group-column-door.ts, packages/services/service-analytics/src/strategies/objectql-strategy.ts, packages/services/service-analytics/src/__tests__/preview-time-filter-fk-parity.test.ts + packages/services/service-analytics/src/index.ts (root exports), packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-compiler.ts (cube `sql`), packages/objectql/src/aggregate-query-shape-door.ts, packages/objectql/src/engine.ts (`aggregate` entry), and every other cited file of the record this one supersedes. The changeset is a prose face: read for ②, not reviewed.

This record supersedes the FAIL record `6563360371` on head `722fbe7c`. It is a delta review: the new head is one fast-forward commit on `722fbe7c` (`d26d29b4`, "build the preview's group keys with a module-level function, not a public strategy method"), touching three files (`analytics-service.ts`, `preview-group-column-door.ts`, `strategies/objectql-strategy.ts`; 109 added / 82 deleted); the parity test and the changeset are byte-identical to the reviewed head. Inputs: the delta diff `722fbe7c..d26d29b4`, the net diff against merge-base `8afaf12d`, the PR body as corrected on the new head, the card's comments (none new since the os-dev-report `6563232009`), and the new head's check-runs. Check-runs at the time of this record: 49 on the head, 28 completed and none failed (success or skipped), 21 in progress: the eight `Test Core (n/8)` shards, Check Changeset, Build Core, Live E2E UI, Type Check · workspace / consumer gates / source gates / debt ledger, Lint · ESLint / repo & tooling gates / CI, release & engine gates / docs & code guards / scoped · slot lookup & corpus / scoped · query-options erasure. The gate verdicts are theirs; the landing check of every check green is the seat's, after they conclude.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **The must-fix is remedied by option (b); the published surface is unwidened — right.** `src/index.ts` is unchanged against `main` (it re-exports `ObjectQLStrategy` alone from this module). The class's public members at the new head are `name`, `priority`, `canHandle`, `execute`, `generateSql` — exactly `main`'s set; `groupByOf` is gone (the remaining `groupByOf` spellings in the package are pre-existing local helpers in three unrelated test files, the same on `main`). The key builder is now the module-level `aggregateGroupKeys(query, cube)`, beside `aggregateObjectOf(cube)` and the module-private `lookupCubeMember` / `resolveCubeFieldName`; they are imported only by `preview-group-column-door.ts`, which is itself imported only into `analytics-service.ts` as a function called inside the private preview branch. No public signature of `ObjectQLStrategy` or `AnalyticsService` names `AggregateGroupKey`, `aggregateGroupKeys` or `aggregateObjectOf`, so none is reachable from the entry type graph; under the published-surface rule (the package's `exports` map and what the entry's type graph reaches) they are shipped bytes, not a published accept set. The service no longer holds a strategy by name; the `builtIn` chain reads `new ObjectQLStrategy()` as on `main`.
2. **Live-face behaviour unchanged — right, read byte for byte.** `aggregateGroupKeys` is the `groupBy` build that `execute` carried on `main` (the `granByDim` map from bucketed `timeDimensions`, one key per `dimensions` entry with its bucket, `granByDim.delete`, then the remaining buckets, each through `pushGroupKey`), with three non-semantic substitutions: the local alias `GroupByItem` becomes the identical union `AggregateGroupKey`, `this.resolveFieldName` becomes `resolveCubeFieldName`, and one comment phrase. `resolveCubeFieldName` is the old `resolveFieldName` body with `lookupCubeMember` in place of `this.lookupMember`, and `lookupCubeMember` is the old `lookupMember` body verbatim; the class's private `lookupMember`, `resolveFieldName` and `extractObjectName` now delegate to the three functions, so every other caller in the strategy reads the same code it did. `execute` calls `aggregateGroupKeys(query, cube)` where it once built inline. `packages/objectql` untouched.
3. **Accept-set narrowing on the draft preview — unchanged and right.** `assertPreviewGroupColumnsDistinct(q, cube)` runs last in the preview gate list as before, builds the keys with the same function `execute` uses, and refuses with the same copied envelope; items 1, 2, 4, 5 and 6 of the superseded record hold as written (two buckets of one column refused on both live faces by the engine door, native declining every bucketed selection to the ObjectQL strategy; the stay-served shapes untouched; no new failure path before the door).

### ② Semver level

- Changeset unchanged: `@objectstack/service-analytics` patch, `Metadata-protocol: none` → `patch` under ruling A; the `!` title, the BREAKING banner and the adr-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` marker are right for a declared `(narrowing)` arm. Level: **matches**.
- `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, PR body and changeset: now **true in the tree**. The body's corrected sentence ("no package-root export, public member, answer member, error code or status is added") is what ① item 1 reads off `src/index.ts` and the class. The diff narrows the preview and widens nothing published.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Should-fix 1 of the superseded record: **done.** The door reads the object through `aggregateObjectOf(cube)` (`cube.sql.trim()`), the same function the strategy's `extractObjectName` now returns, so the name in the preview's message is the one the engine is handed by construction, not by `compileDataset`'s `sql: dataset.object` alone. The dev reports ablation C5 (object read as `cube.name`: 3 failed | 24 passed); the reading is the dev's, the pin it names is the existing field-by-field comparison, which includes `object`.
- Should-fix 2 (a card for the live faces' unreachable remedy sentence, "Give one of the group entries its own 'alias'"): **stands as a lane item, not a blocker**; parity is right here and the card holds the live refusal still.
- All four dev deviations and the empty `open_questions` / `out_of_scope_findings`: unchanged from the superseded record; accepted. `Skills-docs: none` holds. PR author is `objectstack-fleet[bot]` through the relay.
- Observation carried over for the lane: two `timeDimensions` entries of one spelling collapse in `granByDim` to the last granularity on the live faces; the preview evaluator's handling is unmeasured and outside this card.

### ④ Design judgment

The narrowing against the published spec on `main` is as judged before and is not moved by the delta: `queryDataset`'s `previewDrafts` is declared as charting the pending seed rows "before publish", ADR-0037's design center is "exactly what Publish will make real", and the selection schema declares no raw-beside-bucket capability; the preview's refusal makes the spec's own line real at the consumer, and the live refusal does not move. The delta improves the design on the point the FAIL named: one module-level function is now the one source of the engine's keys for `execute` and the door alike, with no new published member and no second strategy instance; the door reads the object as the strategy does. Tried again on the delta: (a) the delegating private methods keep every other strategy caller on the same bytes; (b) the positions remain the engine's by construction (same function, same `q` from the one `DatasetExecutor`); (c) the door's import is one-directional (door → strategy module), no cycle with `analytics-service.ts`; (d) the test file is unchanged, so its three refusal cases and four still-served pins judge the new head as they judged the old; CI's Test Core shards are the reading of record.

Findings: no must-fix. No new should-fix. Should-fix 2 of the superseded record stays with the lane as a card.

## 席位核对 · ACCEPT · PR #28794 · 2026-11-01T21:34Z

Head-sha: `d26d29b40aaf118afde7ab286928849d70991e0d`

**维护者速读(席位终稿)**
- **改了什么**:草稿预览遇到"同一列既要原值又要它的时间桶"或"同一列两个时间桶"时，改为 400 `INVALID_QUERY` 拒绝，消息、`path`、`param`、`object`、`fields` 与原生 SQL、ObjectQL 两面逐字一致。之前预览给出两列，而发布后线上拒绝。
